question: Should ClawHub staff confirm the ShieldCortex namespace/impersonation claim and hide/quarantine or require rename of `@kingaiwork/shieldcortex`?
rationale: The source tree already provides intake and moderation mechanisms; only a human staff decision can weigh real-world brand ownership, publisher impact, and the final namespace disposition.

options.title: Confirm and hide/quarantine
options.body: Use the existing auditable moderation/report path to hide or quarantine the disputed listing, then decide whether a reservation, alias, or rename is needed.

options.title: Ask for more proof
options.body: Keep the issue open and request additional public or private evidence before taking action against the disputed publisher listing.

options.title: Decline action
options.body: Leave the listing active if staff decides the public evidence does not establish impersonation or namespace misuse.

recommendation.title: Confirm and hide/quarantine
recommendation.body: Use the existing auditable moderation/report path to hide or quarantine the disputed listing, then decide whether a reservation, alias, or rename is needed.
